annotations.title: asksteps: the key figures of the studio home page

description: Returns the figures of the asksteps studio home page: whole numbers only, no names and no personal data. Requires "forms:read" or "automation:read". "forms:read" shows publications, inbound sources and WordPress sites; "automation:read" shows cases, appointments, video meetings, processes, workflows and messages. A section is left out when the connection does not cover it (the note says which) or when the user's role does not allow it. A user who may only see their own appointments or cases gets the figures for those.
name: asksteps_get_overview

note.description: One sentence for the user. It says which sections are left out because of the granted permissions.

overview.description: The figures of the studio home page. Only whole numbers and the time of generation. A section is absent when the connection or the user's role does not cover it. Absent unless status is "ok".

status.description: Outcome. One of: "ok", "not_connected", "error". Authorisation can also refuse before the tool runs: "plan_required" (the account's plan does not include agent access), "not_enabled" (the account owner has not switched agent access on), "permission_denied" (the connected user's role lacks the permission; the note names it), "mandate_required" (the owner has not granted a mandate for this). The note then says what the user has to do.

title: asksteps: the key figures of the studio home page
